entries.zh: 居住；住在（某处）
entries.en: to dwell, to reside, to inhabit

entries.zh: 住；居住；停留
entries.en: to live, to stay, to reside

entries.zh: 寄居；寓居（暂住、寄住他处）
entries.en: to lodge, to sojourn; to reside temporarily

entries.zh: 寓居异乡；寄居他人之地
entries.en: to dwell in another's land; to sojourn in a foreign country

entries.zh: 独居；独自居住
entries.en: to live alone, to dwell by oneself

entries.zh: 住在王家学馆（官设馆舍、公学）里
entries.en: to dwell in the king's college (a royally founded hall or seminary)
entries.notes: H 栏「常館」的 M 栏对音与「常」常读不合，collegio del rey 所指机构亦无旁证；释义以 L 栏与「馆舍」义为据。

entries.zh: 说；讲；陈述；表明
entries.en: to speak, to say, to talk; to manifest, to declare
entries.notes: M 栏仅存 sa 一音、R 栏大段污损（T99），示例语无法复原；释义据 L 栏 hablar/decir/parlar/manifestar 与 H 栏「咀」。

entries.zh: 说；讲；解释
entries.en: to speak, to say; to explain

entries.zh: 讲；说话；讲述
entries.en: to speak, to talk, to say

entries.zh: 谈；交谈；谈论（商议）
entries.en: to talk, to converse; to discuss, to consult

entries.zh: 言辞；词语；（以言辞）说话
entries.en: words, speech; to speak, to talk
entries.notes: H 栏「詞」为「言辞」名词义，与 L 栏动词 hablar/parlar 名动相代；M 栏第二音节未能定位成字。

entries.zh: 寡言；沉默（只说必要的话）
entries.en: to be reticent, taciturn; to speak only when necessary

entries.zh: 禀报；报告；告知
entries.en: to report, to announce; to make known

entries.zh: 说话轻率无度；亦指山路高低不平（喻言语起伏无定）
entries.en: to speak rashly, without care; (lit.) an uneven mountain path, i.e. rambling speech
entries.notes: H 栏标 [疑]（崎/峙），M 栏对音未能与「山崎」常读相合；义取 L 栏 sin tiento 与 con alto y bajo 之比。

entries.zh: 说话冗长、絮叨不休（话多而不知收尾）
entries.en: to talk at great length, to ramble on; unable to come to the point
entries.notes: H 栏「給」与「冗长絮叨」义不合，M 栏三音节未能解析，义全据 L 栏 hablar largo…no saben acabar。

entries.zh: 议论；据理而说（讲理、争辩）
entries.en: to speak with reason, to argue one's case; to deliberate
entries.notes: L 栏末句 en bols dice 语义不明，疑原文讹脱；H 栏「議」与 M 栏首音可对，余音未详。

entries.zh: 说粗话；骂人（讲难听的话）
entries.en: to use foul language, to swear, to curse
entries.notes: L 栏 malas palabras 指粗话、骂人话；H 栏「口頭話」字面为「口头之语」，与 L 略不合，M 栏三音可读通。

entries.zh: （两人）亲切交谈；友好地说话
entries.en: (of two people) to speak amicably; friendly talk
entries.notes: dos 指两人对谈；M 栏 sù 与「語」常读不合，属对音存疑而不影响词义。

entries.zh: 讹言；喧嚷乱说（言语嘈杂不清、以讹传讹）
entries.en: to babble noisily; to spread false talk; confused clamor of speech
entries.notes: L 栏严重讹脱（>r<、mamer macaça、tumulto de mi 均难解），仅 H 栏「訛」与 M 栏叠音提示「讹言/喧嚷」，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 嘟囔；含混低声地说（从牙缝里说话）
entries.en: to mutter, to mumble; to speak under one's breath
